channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Minnesota Attorney General Ellison notches early win in case against TikTok
item.description: The lawsuit takes aim at the social media giant’s business practices, alleging an “addictive” design harms children and young people.

item.title: Happy Joe’s hopes Minnesotans are hungry for nostalgia and taco pizza
item.description: Fans of the franchise are looking forward to a summer opening in Mendota Heights.

item.title: Minnesota’s first punk band is playing its last gig
item.description: With one member sidelined by illness, two of the three Suicide Commandos are enlisting some high-profile protégés for a farewell blowout at First Avenue.

item.title: Deadly crash that killed four family members ‘touched so many lives’ in rural Minnesota town
item.description: A crash in southwestern Minnesota on Friday involving an SUV and a family’s party bus left a total of five dead and eight injured.

item.title: Strikes hit Iran and Tehran targets Israel and Gulf states amid mixed signals over talks to end war
item.description: Airstrikes battered Iran and Iranian missiles and drones targeted Israel's Tel Aviv and sites across the Mideast on Tuesday, even as President Donald Trump said the United States was in talks with the Islamic Republic to end the war.

item.title: Springsteen says recent Minneapolis show was his most meaningful ever
item.description: The Boss returns for a rally this weekend, and again on March 31 to kick off a tour with the E Street Band.

item.title: Minnesota Democrats report being followed, harassed by ICE agents during immigration surge
item.description: Federal agents ran Rep. Brad Tabke’s license plate information before leading him to his house in January and February.

item.title: Duluth’s Park Point forest will be set afire so it can ‘take a deep breath’
item.description: A prescribed burn on Duluth’s beloved sandbar aims to help red pines regenerate.

item.title: Many Twin Cities offices are sitting empty. Rents are rising anyway.
item.description: As businesses seek smaller and more luxurious spaces, higher-quality buildings are filling up while others are vacant.

item.title: Review: A fidgety Bob Dylan disappoints in Rochester
item.description: His singing was heartfelt but he had microphone issues bringing it back home.

item.title: Minnesotans’ family recipes and stories are at the heart of ‘Dish & Tell’
item.description: St. Paul author Sarah Peterson serves up nostalgia and comfort in her debut cookbook.

item.title: That text or email about unpaid traffic fines is likely a scam, officials say
item.description: At least 40 people have called Driver and Vehicle Services this week to ask if the messages are real.

item.title: Get to know all the players on the 2026 Twins Opening Day roster
item.description: The Twins finalized their 2026 Opening Day roster before their Thursday opener in Baltimore.

item.title: Iran dismisses US ceasefire plan, issues counterproposal as strikes land across the Mideast
item.description: Iran on Wednesday dismissed an American plan to pause the war in the Middle East and launched more attacks on Israel and Gulf Arab countries, including an assault that sparked a huge fire at Kuwait International Airport.

item.title: Live: Totino-Grace builds double-digit lead against Minneapolis South
item.description: The winner moves into Thursday’s semifinals to face the victor of Mankato East vs. Northfield.
